# FairRound

> Fair token launches on Arbitrum One. A sale runs in hourly rounds; everyone filled in a round pays the same clearing price, at most 150 units sell per round, and oversubscribed rounds fill every bid pro rata. 99% of what buyers pay goes into a project treasury that holders control: every payment is a holder vote with a 5-day delay and a per-term cap, and holders can remove the project lead. Live as a demo: bids use INVEST, a free test credit with no value; the demo launches are fictional.

The site is available in English and Georgian (ქართული). Pages are rendered in the browser and read live data from the contracts.

## Pages

- [Launches](https://fairround.xyz/): all listed demo launches, their round stage, units sold and the raise
- [Join](https://fairround.xyz/citizen): verify a wallet (it must hold at least 0.0083 ETH on Arbitrum One; nothing is taken) and claim 1,000 INVEST test credits, once per wallet
- [Rules](https://fairround.xyz/rules): the rules the contracts enforce, in plain words
- [White paper](https://fairround.xyz/whitepaper): how FairRound works and what isn't solved yet
- [Market](https://fairround.xyz/market): units listed for sale by their holders
- [Portfolio](https://fairround.xyz/portfolio): look up the units, bids, votes and roles of any address

## Key rules

- Rounds: up to 150 units a round, one-hour rounds with a one-hour pause between them. Everyone in a round pays the same clearing price. 99% of what is paid goes to the project treasury, 1% to FairRound. Units lock for 7 days.
- Project lead: elections open at 50% of units sold. A lead wins with yes votes from 20% of the electorate and 51% of votes cast, serves 30 days, and holders can vote to remove them.
- Treasury: every payment, sale or investment is a holder proposal with a 5-day delay before it runs. At most 20% of a bucket can be spent per term.
- New members: at most 50 an hour.
- Admin: every owner change goes through a public 48-hour timelock.

## Contracts (Arbitrum One, verified on Arbiscan)

The contract names are from the project's first version, Sakartvelo Exchange.

- InvestToken: 0x99ED3761F8416342D814ad4CCAe81993c2Ab7e4a
- RoundAuctionV9: 0x65D37C51ec85584222aBA16e6B60B3Cd4BD6090f

- CompanyTreasuryV9: 0x70ffEeAabAaE49cB969ADC8137A3DeD94c8F1B75

- OpenVerifierV2: 0xB055dB6E1291Ac08f581D3ce0a48791b4633AD5A
- SakartveloTimelock (owner, 48-hour delay): 0xBD357971d9935c68c39a2B7e4Fbf33ffC23adF6f
